title: Parametric EQ
description: A parametric equaliser with up to six free bands: each band is a peak, a low or high shelf, a notch, or a low cut or high cut (12 dB per octave) with its own frequency, gain and Q, and can be switched off. Takes audio and gives audio. The eq block stays the simple three-band tone control.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.doc: Off passes the sound through untouched (bypass).

parameters.name: band1_type
parameters.doc: Band 1: peak lifts or cuts around its frequency, lowshelf and highshelf lift or cut everything below or above it, notch removes a narrow band (gain is ignored), lowcut and highcut remove everything below or above the frequency with a 12 dB per octave slope (gain is ignored; Q 0.7 is flat, a higher Q adds a bump at the corner).
parameters.label: Band 1 type

parameters.name: band1_hz
parameters.doc: Band 1: the centre (peak, notch) or corner (shelf) frequency.
parameters.label: Band 1 frequency

parameters.name: band1_gain
parameters.doc: Band 1: how much it lifts (plus) or cuts (minus). 0 dB leaves the band out, so a new block changes nothing until you set a gain.
parameters.label: Band 1 gain

parameters.name: band1_q
parameters.doc: Band 1: how narrow it is. A high Q is a narrow peak or notch; for a shelf it sets the steepness of the corner.
parameters.label: Band 1 Q

parameters.name: band1_enabled
parameters.doc: Band 1: off leaves this band out without losing its settings.
parameters.label: Band 1 enabled

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).
